item.summary: The Directorate General of Taxpayer Services (DGTS) and the CGST Goa Commissionerate highlighted digital-first, taxpayer-centric reform measures being undertaken through the "Bharat Sarkar Aapke Dwaar" initiative in Goa. Shri Sumit Kumar, Principal Additional Director General, DGTS, Mumbai, shared this information during a joint press conference held in Panaji today.
item.title: DGTS and CGST Goa Highlight Digital-First, Taxpayer-Centric Reforms Through "Bharat Sarkar Aapke Dwaar" Initiative – Shri Sumit Kumar
